question: Which of the following is NOT an animal of Phylum Chordate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Earthworm**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Earthworm** is not an animal of **Phylum Chordate**.
 
• Phylum Chordate includes animals that have a notochord, a dorsal nerve cord, pharyngeal slits, an endostyle, and a post-ana
